newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger points to Doug Kidd for Speaker role.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger points to Doug Kidd for Speaker role.

text.p: New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Wednesday that Minister of Energy Doug Kidd was the new coalition government's pick for the role of parliamentary Speaker.
Kidd also holds fisheries, labour and ACC responsibilities.
Bolger was speaking shortly after his caretaker conservative National Party signed a coalition deal with the nationalist New Zealand First Party.
The deal, announced on Tuesday night, ended nearly two months of political suspense over who power-broker NZ First would choose as its coalition partner.
